Pan-STARRS optical all-sky survey false-color stack, faint high-latitude cirrus wisps and asteroid-trail streaks crossing a dense stellar field, characteristic deep-survey aesthetic with slightly softened ground-based PSF across the full sky.

Keck Observatory NIRC2 adaptive-optics near-infrared composite, laser-guide-star-corrected diffraction-limited stellar PSF at 2.2 microns, imaging galactic-center S-star orbits and exoplanet companions with near-space-quality resolution.

Hubble Space Telescope ACS ultraviolet and optical three-filter composite, the Hubble Ultra Deep Field aesthetic of ten-thousand background galaxies at every cosmic epoch filling a single postage-stamp field of pitch-black sky.

INTEGRAL gamma-ray observatory coded-aperture pseudo-color map, hot yellow and white hard-radiation point sources against a diffuse blue galactic-plane background, exposing X-ray binaries and radioactive-decay emission from nucleosynthesis.

Herschel Space Observatory far-infrared PACS and SPIRE composite, pastel rose and pale-blue cold-dust filaments threading interstellar medium at 70-to-500-micron wavelengths, tracing the coldest star-forming clumps invisible to JWST.

VLT SPHERE coronagraphic near-infrared polarimetric image, dark central coronagraph mask surrounded by a razor-thin scattered-light protoplanetary disk with spiral arms and dust gaps rendered in cream and amber false-color.

Fermi Gamma-ray Space Telescope LAT all-sky map, diffuse Milky Way gamma-ray glow in lime-green and yellow with pinpoint blazars and pulsar wind nebulae as saturated white hotspots across the full celestial sphere.

Swift X-ray Telescope and UVOT multiwavelength composite, rapid-response gamma-ray-burst afterglow fading from blue-white UV through orange X-ray, capturing transient events within hours of their cosmological trigger.

LOFAR low-frequency radio array HBA composite at 150 MHz, diffuse steep-spectrum relic-emission cocoons and jellyfish-galaxy radio tails rendered in electric-blue against a deep-navy background revealing ancient AGN fossil lobes.

Gemini Observatory GMOS visible multiband mosaic, rich cluster-field optical composite with color-graded galaxy morphologies from blue irregular starbursts to red elliptical cores showing Butcher-Oemler effect across a single frame.

IXPE X-ray polarimetry imaging composite, polarization-angle vector fields overlaid as golden tick-marks across purple synchrotron nebulae, revealing ordered magnetic-field geometry inside pulsar wind nebulae and supernova remnants for the first time.

Hubble Space Telescope visible-light WFPC2 composite, saturated six-prong diffraction spikes anchoring every foreground star, deep-field aesthetic stacking thousands of background galaxies across billions of light-years.

James Webb Space Telescope NIRCam near-infrared mosaic, eight-prong diffraction spikes radiating from bright stars, burnt-amber molecular hydrogen and cobalt-cyan ionized-gas false-color mapping stellar nurseries.

Chandra X-ray Observatory pseudo-color composite, purple-and-cyan high-energy emission tracing shock fronts, supernova remnant interiors, and accretion-disk coronae invisible at any longer wavelength.

ALMA millimeter-wavelength interferometric map, amber-and-rust false-color thermal continuum revealing protoplanetary disk ring-and-gap structure at sub-arcsecond resolution around young stellar objects.

Event Horizon Telescope 1.3mm VLBI image, blurred amber-orange emission ring surrounding an absolute black shadow, resolving the photon sphere of a supermassive black hole across intergalactic distance.

Spitzer Space Telescope mid-infrared IRAC composite, glowing red-and-gold dust-emission against black, revealing embedded protostars and polycyclic-aromatic-hydrocarbon-lit cloud boundaries completely hidden in visible light.
GALEX ultraviolet NUV-FUV false-color mosaic, blue-and-white UV continuum tracing hot young stellar populations and star-formation rings in spiral galaxies against a dark field.

NASA Roman Space Telescope wide-field near-infrared survey composite, wall-to-wall galaxy coverage across a single enormous frame, faint red-shifted background sources and microlensing fields rendered in warm infrared tones.

ESO Very Large Telescope MUSE optical integral-field composite, emission-line false-color separating hydrogen-alpha red, oxygen-III teal, and nitrogen-II orange across nebular filaments at extraordinary spatial resolution.

Subaru Telescope Hyper Suprime-Cam wide-field visible mosaic, razor-sharp stellar point-spread functions across a degree-scale field, faint tidal streams and low-surface-brightness galaxy halos emerging from deep stacked exposures.
XMM-Newton X-ray EPIC pseudo-color composite, soft-red low-energy and hard-blue high-energy X-ray bands mapped across galaxy cluster atmospheres and AGN jets at arcminute scales.

SDO Solar Dynamics Observatory AIA 171-angstrom extreme-ultraviolet image, golden coronal-loop tracery arcing against a black background, revealing million-degree plasma structures above active solar regions in real time.
Hinode XRT soft X-ray solar image, monochrome silver-and-black high-contrast rendering of coronal jets, flare ribbons, and helmet-streamer boundaries at arcsecond resolution above the solar limb.

VLA Karl G. Jansky Very Large Array centimeter-wavelength radio map, false-color jet lobes and hotspots in shades of orange-to-white, tracing relativistic plasma ejected from radio-galaxy nuclei across hundreds of kiloparsecs.

Pan-STARRS wide-field optical survey composite, natural-color rendered across a multi-degree mosaic, cataloguing asteroid trails, transient supernovae, and faint Milky Way stellar halo structure in a single deep stack.

Keck Observatory near-infrared laser-guide-star adaptive-optics image, diffraction-limited point-spread function at K-band revealing galactic-center stellar orbits crowded within arcseconds of Sagittarius A-star.

Hubble Ultra Deep Field WFC3 infrared parallel, reddened dropout galaxies at z-greater-than-7 embedded among thousands of resolved intermediate-redshift spirals, the faintest objects 31st magnitude against absolute black.

INTEGRAL gamma-ray observatory coded-aperture pseudo-color map, hard X-ray and soft gamma-ray false-color exposing compact object populations and positron-annihilation emission across the Galactic bulge.

Herschel Space Observatory PACS far-infrared mosaic, cold dust filaments glowing in false-color red and yellow at 70-to-500 microns, tracing the densest star-forming ridges inside giant molecular clouds.

Fermi LAT gamma-ray all-sky map, blue-and-white high-energy photon counts rendering the diffuse Galactic plane, blazars, pulsars, and Fermi bubble structures across the full celestial sphere in pseudo-color.

LOFAR low-frequency radio array two-meter-wavelength map, diffuse steep-spectrum synchrotron halos rendered in blue-purple false-color surrounding galaxy clusters and revealing fossil radio plasma invisible at higher frequencies.

Gemini Observatory GMOS visible deep composite, photometric-redshift color-coded galaxy clusters overlaid on natural-color imaging, precise point-spread function enabling weak-gravitational-lensing shear measurement across wide fields.
